# Comprehensive Learning Guide: Introduction to HTML for Beginners ## Course Overview This course provides a foundational understanding of **HTML (HyperText Markup Language)**, the fundamental building block of all web pages. Over 81 practice tasks, you'll learn how to structure content semantically, create accessible web documents, and prepare for modern web development roles. **Who This Is For:** - Complete beginners entering web development - Career-changers transitioning into tech - Students preparing for front-end or full-stack roles - Anyone building a portfolio for junior developer positions **Why It Matters for Interview Prep:** - **HTML knowledge is non-negotiable** for front-end engineering roles—interviewers expect solid fundamentals - Understanding semantic HTML demonstrates code quality and accessibility awareness - Strong HTML foundation makes learning CSS and JavaScript significantly faster - Real-world web development always begins with proper HTML structure - Many junior-level interviews include HTML/CSS live coding or markup assessments --- ## Core Topics Covered - **HTML Document Structure & Boilerplate**: DOCTYPE, ``, ``, `` tags and their purposes - **Text Semantics**: Headings, paragraphs, emphasis (``, ``), and semantic text elements - **Links & Navigation**: Absolute vs. relative URLs, anchor tags, `target` attributes, and navigation patterns - **Lists & Organization**: Ordered lists, unordered lists, definition lists, and nested list structures - **Forms & Input Elements**: Form creation, input types, labels, validation, and accessibility - **Media & Embedded Content**: Images, video, audio, and figure/figcaption elements - **Semantic HTML5 Elements**: `
